item.title: AI Engineer, webbyfox consultancy
item.description: Job Title AI Engineer Job Description We're looking for an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship AI-powered features for our clients' Python web applications. You'll take LLM and machine learning ideas from prototype to production, adding AI search, intelligent agents, and automation to Django and FastAPI products. You'll work closely with our senior Python engineers and with client teams. Key responsibilities: - Design and build LLM-powered features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

item.description: The Python Steering Council and the Python Software Foundation are looking to hire the next CPython Developer-in-Residence. The position is full-time and remote, and is open to applicants inside and outside the US. Background CPython, the reference implementation of Python, is developed and primarily maintained by volunteers.
